title: Nadia Finally Checked Where $4,940 a Year Went

scenes.say: $4,940 a year, in little boxes. Nadia finally checked her orders.
No big buys. Just about $95 a week, a few small orders at a time.
$95 a week, times 52 weeks. That's about $4,940.
Half of it, she couldn't even remember buying.
So she set one rule: a $40 weekly cap, and one order day, Sunday.
$95 down to $40 keeps about $55 a week.
By the end of the year, that's roughly $2,860 still in her account.
How much did you order last month? Subscribe so you don't make this mistake on your next paycheck, because right now, it's $95 a week, gone.

description: Nadia never made big purchases, but small online orders added up to about $95 a week, or roughly $4,940 a year. A $40 weekly cap and one order day keep about $2,860 a year. Numbers are rounded US estimates.
